content.summary: The vacuity objection is valid but explicitly answered at the appropriate level: accepting the external I(27) result empties the hypothetical class, while the local development still needs a checked exclusion. Capacity 53 remains a formal reduction target, without furnishing an extremal improvement or a claim that 53 is optimal. Frozen hashes match.

checks.method: Read F17's reported maximum 27, enumeration explanation, and A1K T7/T8; compared their logical implications with the manuscript's scope and concluding limitations.
checks.observation: The external maximum implies nonexistence at every support size, so 53 cannot be a sharp support extremum for actual 28-member examples. The manuscript acknowledges emptiness and instead offers a smaller premise for a future kernel-checked refutation. Its generic moment arguments also have hypotheses outside this empty class. No claim of improved f(4,3) follows or is made.
